world.title: Joe Biden's cancer has spread further, condition very painful, says son Hunter
world.summary: Hunter Biden revealed that his father, former President Joe Biden, is experiencing severe pain as his prostate cancer has spread beyond his bones. This update comes as Joe Biden continues with treatment and public engagements. Hunter discussed his father's health during an interview with the BBC, providing a concerning insight into the former president's ongoing medical challenges.

world.title: US rejects China’s Scarborough Reef measures, backs Philippines in South China Sea dispute
world.summary: The United States has dismissed China's efforts to establish a "national nature reserve" at Scarborough Reef, labeling it destabilizing. The US accused China of using environmental and legal arguments to further its maritime claims in the South China Sea. This stance reaffirms US support for the Philippines amid ongoing territorial disputes in the region.

world.title: Mecca Agreement | A new triple alliance in West Asia
world.summary: The Mecca Agreement establishes a trilateral alliance between Saudi Arabia, Pakistan, and Turkiye aimed at enhancing collective security in response to regional instability. This partnership seeks to address shared security concerns and strengthen cooperation among the three nations. The agreement reflects a strategic move to bolster regional ties amid ongoing challenges in West Asia.

business.title: ‘Kitna deti hai?’ is no longer enough as Indian car buyers start doing the maths beyond mileage and EMI
business.summary: Indian car buyers are shifting their focus from just mileage and purchase price to a comprehensive evaluation of total ownership costs. This includes factors such as fuel or electricity expenses, maintenance, insurance, financing, and resale value. The trend is accelerating as various vehicle types, including petrol, CNG, hybrid, and electric, compete for consumer attention in the market.

business.title: Milk prices in Maharashtra to rise by Rs 2; check reason and date of rate hike
business.summary: Milk prices in Maharashtra will increase by Rs 2 per litre for cow and buffalo milk, effective August 11. This decision was made by major cooperative and private dairies following a welfare association meeting. The rise is attributed to increasing diesel prices and packaging costs. Additionally, dairy product prices may rise by up to ten percent.

business.title: For medium- to long-term investors seeking sustainable growth: 5 large- and mid-caps with upside potential of up to 28%
business.summary: Investors are advised to focus on sustainable growth opportunities in a recovering market, rather than chasing momentum stocks. Identifying businesses that can maintain steady growth regardless of market fluctuations is crucial. Some sectors may currently appear promising but could face challenges ahead. A few resilient companies are likely to provide stability and consistent demand, supporting long-term investment portfolios.

technology.title: Dynaudio's wild soundbar with moving 'kinetic fins' is one of the most impressive I've ever seen — I spoke to the company's CCO about building a luxe soundbar for giant TVs and its impressive 24-drive
technology.summary: Dynaudio showcased a unique soundbar featuring moving wooden fins at High End Vienna, impressing attendees with its power and design. The company's Chief Commercial Officer discussed the creation of this luxurious soundbar, designed for large televisions, highlighting its 24-drive system. The event featured various audio innovations, including flagship speakers and advanced headphones, attracting significant interest from audio enthusiasts.

technology.title: Microsoft confirms it accidentally installed new OneDrive app on Windows 11 PCs, and there's no easy way to remove it yet
technology.summary: Microsoft confirmed it mistakenly installed the AI-powered OneDrive Photos app on Windows 11 PCs more widely than intended. This has affected enterprise PCs, where the app is non-functional. Users are currently facing challenges in removing the app, as there is no straightforward solution available. Microsoft has indicated that a fix is forthcoming to address the situation.

technology.title: Google Drive Ending Photo Backup
technology.summary: Google will discontinue automatic photo backup from Google Drive for desktop to Google Photos starting August 10, 2026. Users relying on this feature should prepare for the change, although existing photos will remain accessible. This decision affects those who utilize Google Drive on their computers for photo management, marking a significant shift in how Google handles photo backups.

sports.title: Player Ratings: Ferencvaros 1 - 2 Real Madrid
sports.summary: Real Madrid defeated Ferencvaros 2-1 in a recent match, with notable performances from Güler and Ciria. Güler was highlighted for his exceptional play, while Ciria also impressed with his skills. Additionally, Espí marked a significant milestone by scoring his first goal for Real Madrid. The match showcased the team's talent and potential as they continue their campaign.

sports.title: Brett Lee shuts down Vaibhav Sooryavanshi age debate: 'Everyone away from India asks if he's 15. Who cares?'
sports.summary: Brett Lee addressed the age controversy surrounding Indian cricketer Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, stating that opinions from outside India are irrelevant. He expressed confidence in Sooryavanshi's potential for future success, despite a challenging start in international cricket. The teenager's impressive performances in the IPL led to his selection for India's T20I squad, where he showed improvement during the Zimbabwe tour.

sports.title: SUS vs HAM Today Match Prediction and Betting Tips, Odds and Live Score
sports.summary: Sussex (SUS) will host Hampshire (HAM) in the England Domestic One-Day Cup 2026 on August 9, 2026, at County Ground, Hove. Sussex aims to end a losing streak, having secured only one victory in six matches. The match is part of Group B, and it is scheduled to start at 15:30 IST. Betting tips and odds are available.

health.title: Why you suddenly need to pee when you’re stressed: Doctor explains how stress signals travel between the brain and bladder
health.summary: Stress can trigger a sudden urge to urinate, even when the bladder isn't full. The brain and bladder communicate constantly; as urine accumulates, nerves signal fullness to the brain, which decides when to urinate. Stress alters awareness of bladder sensations, leading to increased urgency. Dr. Jaydeep Jain notes that stress affects urination patterns, causing more frequent restroom visits.

health.title: Antibiotics and Fever
health.summary: Dr. Raghav Gupta highlights that many individuals develop fevers from common infections annually. A common response among families is to purchase antibiotics from pharmacies or use leftover medications. This practice raises concerns, as inappropriate antibiotic use can lead to resistance and adverse effects. Gupta emphasizes the importance of consulting healthcare professionals for proper diagnosis and treatment rather than self-medicating.

health.title: 15 cases in Jul, 11 in Aug: Dengue stings city
health.summary: Lucknow has reported 15 dengue cases in July and 11 in the first five days of August, indicating a seasonal rise associated with the monsoon. Health officials have not identified any hotspots but are urging residents to eliminate stagnant water and monitor for symptoms. Precautionary measures are emphasized to prevent further spread of the disease.

science.title: Solar eclipse to occur next week. Here is what to know
science.summary: A solar eclipse will take place next Wednesday, visible in parts of Europe and the U.S. Observers in Iceland, Greenland, northern Russia, Spain, and a section of Portugal will experience a total eclipse. In the U.S., a partial eclipse will be seen in various regions. Astronomers advise safety measures for viewing the event to protect eyesight.

science.title: Most U.S. coastal wetlands are slowly disappearing underwater
science.summary: Rising sea levels are submerging 84 percent of U.S. coastal wetlands, including salt marshes and mangroves. A new map identifies which wetlands can be preserved through management interventions. These ecosystems play a crucial role in storm protection and biodiversity. As they continue to disappear, the urgency for effective conservation strategies becomes increasingly important to mitigate further loss.
